name: Beasts of the Sea (1/Day)
description: The creature magically calls 2d4 giant crabs, 2 giant sea horses or reef sharks, or 1 swarm of quippers, provided the creature is underwater. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the creature and obeying its telepathic commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the creature dies, or until the creature dismisses them as a bonus action.
